instructions: {lead} The red round bird must pass through the gap between the upper and lower green posts ahead of it. Flapping makes it jump up a lot, so it should flap only when it is both below the middle of the gap and falling {now}. Should it flap now?

criteria.flap: Flap: the bird is below the middle of the gap and falling
criteria.wait: Wait: the bird is above the middle of the gap, or it is still rising
